svg.title: EVSpendPure symbol
svg.metadata: EVSpendPure canonical symbol. C3 EV (EVSpend Brand Kit 2.0 C3, mono.sign C3) with the Signature Cut: band through the right V arm only, 24 deg from vertical leaning top left (parallel to the left V arm), lower cut edge starts at the inner top corner of the right arm (375.64|138), upper edge leaves the top line at x=388.78, gap 12 units in the 512 grid. Small form (16 to 32 px): no cut. Colours: E #FFFFFF, V #10E0A0 on #0A0F0D. All exports derive from brand.py.
